about: Store-game anchor: our before-phone shot vs a cropped store screenshot of a finished game, side by side without labels. See README.md.

judge.how: claude -p --safe-mode --tools Read, one call per pair, sheet.png alone in a fresh empty mkdtemp dir as cwd; unparseable answer re-asked once
judge.question:
First open sheet.png in the current directory with the Read tool. It shows two screenshots side by side, LEFT and RIGHT, each from a different 3D mobile game. Interface text is cropped away, so judge only the game scene. Which one looks like a finished game from an app store – polished art, lighting and materials and readable characters, rather than an unfinished prototype? End your reply with exactly one line in this form and nothing after it:
VERDICT: LEFT – <one short reason>
or
VERDICT: RIGHT – <one short reason>

order.prng: pure-rand xoroshiro128plus + uniformInt(0, 1) per pair in sentence order, game after game; 0 = ours is LEFT
